title: Evacuees from Oleshky promptly issued documents and bank cards – Lubinets
summary: Residents evacuated from Oleshky were promptly issued documents and bank cards while staying at the Kyiv Regional Hospital. They are already receiving assistance from the Ukrainian government and international partners.

title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,710 over past day
summary: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to November 14, 2026, have reached approximately 1,620,630 personnel, including 1,710 troops killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

title: Trump to meet with Xi and Putin next Thursday – New York Post
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump will hold a trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian leader Vladimir Putin on November 19 in Shenzhen, China, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit.

title: Evacuees from Oleshky receive medical and social assistance in Zakarpattia region
summary: Residents evacuated from the temporarily occupied city of Oleshky in the Kherson region continue to arrive in the Zakarpattia region, where they are receiving medical, social and psychological assistance.

title: Europe must learn modern warfare from Ukraine – ARX Robotics CEO
summary: European armies must learn from Ukraine's experience in modern warfare and accelerate the adoption of new military technologies to avoid falling behind Russia in critical areas.

title: Zelensky holds meeting with mayors on winter preparations, says talks will be regular
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has discussed preparations by communities across Ukraine for the winter period amid continued Russian attacks with mayors from different parts of the country.

title: Schiphol Airport donates 29 passenger buses to Ukraine
summary: The Netherlands' largest airport, Schiphol, has donated 29 passenger buses to Ukraine. The buses were previously used to transport passengers from aircraft to the terminal.

title: Ukraine has lost 630 locomotives to Russian attacks, nearly 400 of them this year – Kalashnyk
summary: Ukraine has lost 630 locomotives as a result of Russian attacks since the start of the full-scale invasion, with nearly 400 of those losses occurring this year.

title: Russia designates Ukraine's Yellow Ribbon resistance movement ‘extremist organization’
summary: Russia has designated the Yellow Ribbon Ukrainian resistance movement an “extremist organization” and banned its activities on Russian territory.

title: SSU foils Russian plot to strike Kyiv, arrests suspected agent spying on military positions
summary: The Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) has detained a man in Kyiv suspected of helping guide Russian missile and drone attacks and prepare new strikes against Ukrainian Defense Forces units and civilian facilities in the capital.

title: National Guard drones hit over 316,000 enemy targets since Russia’s full-scale invasion – Pivnenko
summary: Since the start of Russia’s full-scale invasion, Ukrainian National Guard unmanned systems crews have hit more than 316,000 enemy targets, nearly 150,000 of which have been destroyed.

title: Remains of Russian drone recovered from Dnipro River in Kyiv
summary: Rescuers have recovered the remains of an enemy drone from the Dnipro River in Kyiv's Obolonskyi district. The debris fell into the river during a Russian attack on November 11.
